blocks.name: fnv1a_32_ints
blocks.summary: 32-bit FNV-1a deterministic byte payload hash with standard offset basis 0x811c9dc5
blocks.pseudocode: 1. h = 0x811c9dc5; 2. for b in data: h = ((h ^ b) * 0x01000193) & 0xffffffff

pitfalls.failure_mechanism: Zero initialization collapses all-zero prefixes to hash 0

blocks.teleological_intent: Non-cryptographic uniform hash distribution over byte frames

blocks.name: stable_logsumexp
blocks.summary: Shifted numerically stable LogSumExp preventing exp(x) overflow for x >= 710
blocks.pseudocode: 1. m = max(xs); 2. return m + log(sum(exp(x - m) for x in xs))
blocks.teleological_intent: Log-partition function free-energy normalization without IEEE-754 overflow

blocks.name: symplectic_leapfrog_step
blocks.summary: Symplectic Velocity Verlet / Leapfrog step preserving phase-space volume (det J == 1)
blocks.pseudocode: 1. v_half = v - 0.5*dt*k*x; 2. x_new = x + dt*v_half; 3. v_new = v_half - 0.5*dt*k*x_new

pitfalls.naive_pattern: x_new = x + dt*v; v_new = v - dt*k*x
pitfalls.failure_mechanism: Explicit Euler inflates phase-space area det J = 1 + k*dt^2 > 1

blocks.teleological_intent: Liouville theorem phase-space volume conservation in Hamiltonian mechanics
blocks.dimensional_units: x: m, v: m/s, k: 1/s^2, dt: s -> tuple[m, m/s]

blocks.name: welford_variance
blocks.summary: Welford single-pass online variance avoiding subtractive cancellation at kappa >= 10^8
blocks.pseudocode: 1. Track running mean and M2 = sum((x - mean_old)*(x - mean_new)); 2. return M2 / n
blocks.source_code:
def welford_variance(xs: list[float]) -> float:
    if not xs:
        return 0.0
    count = 0
    mean = 0.0
    m2 = 0.0
    for x in xs:
        count += 1
        delta = x - mean
        mean += delta / count
        delta2 = x - mean
        m2 += delta * delta2
    return m2 / count

pitfalls.failure_mechanism: Severe precision loss from subtractive cancellation when kappa >= 10^8
pitfalls.verified_fix: Use Welford online delta * delta2 update

blocks.teleological_intent: Orthogonal running residual accumulation preserving mantissa bits on shifted streams
